meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin **acne-prone** hai aur budget **₹700 ke andar** hai, to sabse safe aur useful pick usually **2% Salicylic Acid serum** hota hai, kyunki ye pores unclog karke active acne aur blackheads dono par kaam karta hai.[5][9][12]

**Best options under ₹700 in India:**
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — ₹439 on Nykaa; active acne aur oily skin ke liye strong budget option.[5]
- **Minimalist Salicylic Acid 2% Face Serum** — starting around ₹237 on Minimalist; acne, oily skin, blackheads ke liye directly targeted.[9]
- **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acne Control Serum** — ₹399 on Hindi coverage/retail listings; acne-prone aur irritated skin ke liye gentler-feeling option.[11][5]
- **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum** — ₹526; salicylic acid + niacinamide combo acne aur acne marks dono ke liye useful hota hai.[1]
- **Minimalist Niacinamide 5% Face Serum** — ₹569–₹599; acne marks, oil balance, aur irritated skin ke liye better if your acne is not very active.[9][5]

**Mera simple recommendation:**
- **Active pimples / blackheads:** **Salicylic Acid 2% serum**
- **Oiliness + acne marks:** **Niacinamide 5% serum**
- **Dono chahiye ek hi product me:** **Sali-Cinamide serum**

Agar aap **oily skin** wale ho, to main pehle **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid** ya **Minimalist Salicylic Acid 2%** suggest karunga.[5][9]  
Agar aapki skin **sensitive** hai ya zyada irritation hoti hai, to **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic** better pick ho sakta hai.[5][11]

**Use kaise karein:**
- Raat me 1 baar se start karein
- Pehle 2–3 din/hafta use karein
- Saath me **moisturizer** zaroor lagayein
- Din me **sunscreen** use karein

Agar aap chahein, main aapke skin type ke hisaab se **top 3 exact pick** kar dunga: **oily, sensitive, ya combination**.
